research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Erasca is researching small molecule KRAS inhibitors, including tricyclic KRAS G12C and G12D inhibitors, amide and urea containing tricyclic KRAS inhibitors, aminoheterocycle substituted tricyclic KRAS inhibitors, selective KRAS inhibitors, and KRAS inhibitor conjugates, as described in titles such as Tricyclic KRAS inhibitors and Tricyclic pyridones and pyrimidones and in abstracts focused on compounds of Formula I for treating cancer. These efforts span precision targeting of KRAS driven malignancies.

overview_description.description:
Erasca develops oncology drugs intended to provide precision oncology options. The company's drugs are being developed through multiple discovery programs for undisclosed targets that are biological drivers of cancer and are pursuing additional opportunities for pipeline expansion through academic and biopharmaceutical collaborations, providing patients with new potential solutions to not just treat but cure cancer.

Erasca was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in San Diego, California.

product.name: ERAS-0015
product.description: An oral pan-RAS molecular glue designed to inhibit RAS signaling in RAS-mutant solid tumors.

product.name: ERAS-4001
product.description: An oral pan-KRAS inhibitor targeting KRAS-mutant solid tumors with selectivity over HRAS and NRAS.

product.name: Naporafenib
product.description: A pan-RAF inhibitor developed for RAS/MAPK pathway-driven tumors, including NRAS-mutant melanoma.

product.name: ERAS-3490
product.description: An oral KRAS G12C inhibitor with central nervous system penetration for KRAS G12C-mutated solid tumors.

product.name: ERAS-007
product.description: An ERK1/2 inhibitor targeting downstream nodes of the RAS/MAPK pathway in solid tumors.

product.name: ERAS-601
product.description: An oral SHP2 inhibitor targeting upstream signaling in the RAS/MAPK pathway for solid tumors.
